package_pipeline: RunUAT BuildCookRun Development Win64, explicit /Game/XinyiV2/L_XinyiV2_Contract_WP (documented command)
repeat_protocol: Each repeat is its own run ID: fresh snapshot, regenerated v2 plan (must equal SHA 235bfd9573c84b3ddab7da5b588d33c3f1263f50b6f24f1cdbbc8490a46b6531), copy of this run's package without runtime Saved.
Before each pair: wait for 30 s with no UnrealEditor/UnrealEditor-Cmd process; record other-editor samples during the pair.
Order within each pair: Baseline then ComplexAsSimple, via tools/unreal_xinyi_v2/run_complex_candidate.ps1.
After each pair: validate_complex_candidate.py and verify_snapshot_unchanged.ps1.
All 5 repeats are run and reported regardless of earlier outcomes; none is discarded or rerun.
per_repeat_classification: PASS only if both processes complete, validator candidate_correctness=PASS (15/15 first-hit tile and 2 cm distance, 27/27 negatives, 4/4 sweeps, dynamic, 25/25 enum 3, 101/101 streaming) and source immutability PASS.
stall_reporting: Any FAIL_STEP_TIMEOUT / FAIL_DYNAMIC_STREAM_TIMEOUT in either mode is reported with step_timeout_diagnostics false terms. Per-step streaming_predicate false-tick counts and the longest wait are summarised for all processes.
verdict_policy: Run 20261016T065302Z-07740159 stays FAIL and unexplained. Consistent with its disposition, this session does not issue COMPLEX_AS_SIMPLE_CORRECTNESS_PASS from these repeats; it reports the per-repeat results and the observed stall rate for the owner's decision. Any instrumented stall is itself a correctness FAIL for that repeat.
performance: Within-pair candidate/baseline ratios only; no thresholds; pairs with other-editor contention flagged.
